mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in housing starts (HOUST) over two months reflects strong consumer confidence and rising residential investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved corporate revenue outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST grows over two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic regimes with unemployment below 4.0%, labor market tightness increases inflation risks and policy tightening probability, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE signal in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
